title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
slides: Shopify just opened its catalog — who benefits most?
AI agents can now access millions of product listings
But only approved partners get full data access
Sellers gain new sales channels beyond Google and Amazon
Test one product feed with an AI agent today
thread_text:
1. Shopify's Quiet Power Move

Millions of product listings are now accessible to AI agents — but only approved partners get the full data. The rest get scraps.

2. Who Really Wins Here?

Sellers suddenly have a new sales channel that bypasses Google and Amazon entirely. That's not a feature — that's leverage.

3. The Gatekeeper Problem

Approved partners control the pipe. If you're not on the list, your products might as well not exist to these agents.

4. Beyond the Duopoly

For the first time, merchants can reach buyers without feeding the Google or Amazon ad machine. The question is whether they'll actually do it.

5. Your Move Today

Pick one product, test a feed with an AI agent, and see if it converts. If you haven't tried it yet, that's your starting point.

Millions of product listings just became readable by AI agents — but only for approved partners.

Shopify opened its catalog so AI agents can pull product data and surface items to buyers. 🛒
